name: enable_selected_object_motion

stack.evidence: func_001CF6C8 queues operation type 15 without accessing the Script value stack; the object-operation dispatcher clears the motion-disable flag 0x200000000 in the selected object's flags at +0x440

notes: Operation type 15 maps to the embedded MOTION_ON name. It clears the same disable flag that type 16 sets.
